profileEvidence.summary: Lively and people-oriented, the American Bullnese tends to bond closely with its household. It often enjoys outings and training with the right motivation, while an alert streak adds a watchful side. Robert “Bobby” Rice developed the breed in Jacksonville in the late 1980s, drawing on five breeds to create a distinct companion line.
